prior_semantics: Shared unconditional 3D frame prior; the 20-frame joint prior factorizes. The native-time trajectory likelihood couples frames. No learned temporal joint prior is claimed.
missing_support: Training-only supported-cell loss plus independent Gaussian nuisance latent score, fixed nuisance weight 1; support is never a model or posterior input.
time_measure: One trapezoid-weighted random native frame per train window per epoch; validation evaluates all native frames with trapezoid weights.
notes: No trajectory encoder or observations in prior training.
DDIM-DPS50 is an explicitly accelerated approximate sampler.
Reference fields, support, true 3D tracks and probes are unavailable to posterior reconstruction.
Resource caps are allocation limits, not duration forecasts.
